tasks.label: probe-rs gdb server
args: probe-rs gdb --gdb-connection-string localhost:1337 --chip LPC55S69JBD100 --probe 1366:0105:000720762184 --protocol swd --speed 100 "${workspaceFolder}/target/thumbv8m.main-none-eabihf/debug/lpc55s69" & echo $! > "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/probe-rs-gdb.pid"; wait $!

tasks.label: stop probe-rs gdb server
args: if [ -f "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/probe-rs-gdb.pid" ]; then kill "$(cat "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/probe-rs-gdb.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "${workspaceFolder}/.vscode/probe-rs-gdb.pid"; fi
